clauses.heading: FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT
clauses.text: THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT, dated effective as of March 27, 2019 (the "First Amendment"), is entered into by and among EMPIRE LOUISIANA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Original Borrower" or "EL") and EMPIRE NORTH DAKOTA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("END", together with the Original Borrower are sometimes referred to herein collectively as the "Borrower") and CROSSFIRST BANK, a Kansas state-chartered bank (the "Bank").
clauses.plain_english: This clause identifies the parties involved in the amendment to the loan agreement, specifically adding Empire North Dakota LLC as a co-borrower alongside Empire Louisiana LLC, with CrossFirst Bank as the lender.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard introductory clause identifying the parties and the nature of the agreement. It carries minimal risk as it merely establishes the legal identity of the participants in the amendment.

clauses.heading: 1. Definitions. Capitalized terms used herein and not otherwise
clauses.text:
"Guaranty Agreement" means that certain Amended and Restated Guaranty Agreement of even date herewith, from Guarantor, in favor of Bank, in form, scope and substance acceptable to Bank.
"Revolver Commitment Amount" shall be the maximum outstanding principal amount plus Letter of Credit Exposure the Bank agrees from time to time to make available under the Revolver Commitment (initially stipulated to be equal to $9,000,000.00), subject to the QCR.
"Revolver Final Maturity Date" shall mean March 27, 2021, unless otherwise extended or renewed in writing by the mutual agreement of the Borrower and the Bank.
"QCR" shall have the meaning given in Section 2.13 of the Loan Agreement.
clauses.plain_english: This clause defines key terms used in the agreement, including the Guaranty Agreement, the Revolver Commitment Amount (capped at $9,000,000), the Revolver Final Maturity Date (March 27, 2021), and the QCR.
clauses.risk_justification: These are standard definitions for a loan amendment. The maturity date and commitment amounts are specific and clearly defined.

clauses.heading: 2. Revolver Commitment. The Revolver Commitment is hereby increa
clauses.text: sed and renewed to the Revolver Final Maturity Date, subject to the Revolver Commitment Amount, the Collateral Borrowing Base limitations and QCR described below. All of the Indebtedness created pursuant thereto is evidenced by that certain replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note) dated as of March 27, 2019, from the Borrower payable to the order of the Bank in the maximum principal amount of $20,000,000.00 (subject to the Revolver Commitment Amount and the Collateral Borrowing Base). The Revolver Commitment Amount and the Collateral Borrowing Base are stipulated to be set at $9,000,000.00 as of the effective date of this First Amendment, which increase shall be in accordance with and satisfy the Collateral Borrowing Base Redeterminations under Section 4.2 of the Loan Agreement for April 2019.
clauses.plain_english: This clause increases and renews the Revolver Commitment up to the maturity date, subject to specific borrowing base limitations. It confirms that the debt is evidenced by a replacement Promissory Note for up to $20,000,000.00, while setting the current commitment and borrowing base at $9,000,000.00 as of the amendment date.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause formalizes an increase in credit capacity and references existing loan documentation. The risks are standard for a commercial loan amendment and are subject to defined borrowing base limitations.
obligations: Borrower must adhere to the Revolver Commitment Amount and Collateral Borrowing Base limitations
Borrower must satisfy the Collateral Borrowing Base Redeterminations under Section 4.2 of the Loan Agreement for April 2019
rights: Bank has the right to receive payment evidenced by the Revolver Note
Borrower has the right to access credit up to the stipulated Revolver Commitment Amount

clauses.heading: Loan Origination Fee
clauses.text: Borrower shall pay to Bank a fully earn and non-refundable loan origination fee equal to $76,900.00 (one hundred basis points (1.00%) on the $7,690,000.00 increase in the Revolver Commitment Amount).
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower is required to pay the Bank a non-refundable fee of $76,900.00 as a cost for the increase in the loan commitment amount.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard, fixed-fee payment obligation associated with a loan amendment. The fee is clearly defined and non-refundable, which is typical for origination fees in commercial lending.
obligations: Borrower shall pay to Bank a loan origination fee of $76,900.00
rights: Bank is entitled to receive a non-refundable loan origination fee of $76,900.00

clauses.heading: 2.12 Payment of Fees. All fees payable under Sections 2.4, 2.5, 2.
clauses.text: 2.10 and 2.14 shall be paid on the dates due, in immediately available funds, US Dollars, to Bank and shall be fully earned and non-refundable under any circumstances.
clauses.plain_english: Fees required under sections 2.10 and 2.14 must be paid to the Bank in US Dollars by their respective due dates, and once paid, these fees cannot be refunded for any reason.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard payment clause requiring fees to be paid in immediately available funds and establishing them as non-refundable, which is common in commercial loan agreements.
obligations: Pay fees under Sections 2.10 and 2.14 to Bank on the dates due in immediately available US Dollars
rights: Bank has the right to receive fees as non-refundable

clauses.heading: 5. Quarterly Commitment Reduction. The following replaces Sectio
clauses.text: 5. Quarterly Commitment Reduction. The following replaces Section 2.13 of the Existing Loan Agreement in its entirety:
clauses.plain_english: This clause serves as an amendment to replace the existing Section 2.13 of the original loan agreement with new terms regarding the reduction of the loan commitment on a quarterly basis.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard administrative amendment clause that replaces a specific section of the agreement. It does not contain substantive financial terms itself, but rather sets the stage for the replacement of terms.

clauses.heading: 2.13 Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR). On the last day of each
clauses.text: calendar quarter, commencing June 30, 2019, the Revolver Commitment Amount shall automatically be reduced by $150,000.00 per quarter (the "QCR"), and Borrower shall make any principal payment necessary to comply with the QCR. Such principal payment shall be in addition to the regularly scheduled interest payment. The definition of "MCR" and all references to "MCR" in the Existing Loan Agreement are hereby deleted.
clauses.plain_english: Starting June 30, 2019, the total available loan amount (Revolver Commitment) will decrease by $150,000 every quarter. The Borrower is required to make principal payments to match these reductions, which are separate from regular interest payments. Additionally, the term 'MCR' is removed from the original loan agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: This clause imposes a mandatory, recurring principal reduction schedule that accelerates the repayment of the loan, which may impact the Borrower's liquidity. It is a standard feature in revolving credit facilities but creates a firm financial obligation.
obligations: Borrower shall make principal payments to comply with the $150,000.00 quarterly reduction of the Revolver Commitment Amount.
deadlines: Last day of each calendar quarter, commencing June 30, 2019

clauses.heading: 2.14 Loan Amendment Fee. For each amendment or other change to
clauses.text: this Agreement that is required (in the sole discretion of the Bank) as a result of a change in terms or conditions requested by Borrower, Borrower shall pay Bank a fee in an amount equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding, multiplied by twenty five basis points (0.25%), which fee shall be payable in immediately available funds concurrent with the closing of such amendment.
clauses.plain_english: If the Borrower requests a change to the loan agreement and the Bank agrees to it, the Borrower must pay the Bank a fee equal to 0.25% of the outstanding Revolver Commitment Amount at the time the amendment is finalized.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause imposes a mandatory fee based on the total outstanding commitment amount rather than a flat administrative fee, which could result in significant costs for the Borrower depending on the size of the loan.
obligations: Borrower shall pay Bank a fee equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding multiplied by 0.25% upon the closing of an amendment requested by Borrower.
rights: Bank has the right to collect a fee for amendments requested by the Borrower.
deadlines: concurrent with the closing of such amendment

clauses.heading: 7. Financial Statements and Reports. Section 6.6(a) and the firs
clauses.text: 6.6(b) of the Existing Loan Agreement are hereby modified to provide that the Guarantor will furnish such Financial Statements and Reports pursuant to the terms of the Guaranty Agreement.
clauses.plain_english: This clause updates the existing loan agreement to specify that the Guarantor must provide financial statements and reports according to the rules set out in the separate Guaranty Agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard administrative amendment clarifying the reporting obligations of the Guarantor by cross-referencing an existing document (the Guaranty Agreement). It does not impose new, unusual, or onerous burdens.
obligations: Guarantor must furnish Financial Statements and Reports pursuant to the terms of the Guaranty Agreement.

clauses.heading: Net Lease Operating Reports
clauses.text: (c) Net Lease Operating Reports. No later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter, reports regarding leases in the same form as they are received by the operator under each applicable operators agreement.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrowers must provide the Bank with copies of lease reports within 60 days after the end of each calendar quarter, using the same format the operator receives under their agreements.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard reporting obligation common in loan agreements to ensure the lender has visibility into the collateral's performance. The 60-day window is reasonable.
obligations: Provide reports regarding leases to the Bank no later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter.
deadlines: No later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter

clauses.heading: Section 28 (Minimum Leverage Ratio) and Section 29 (Minimum
clauses.text:
Interest Coverage
Ratio) of the Existing Loan Agreement shall be measured for Borrower on a combined
basis using consolidated financial statements provided by the Guarantor.
clauses.plain_english: The financial ratios (Interest Coverage Ratio) required by the loan agreement must be calculated by combining the financial results of the Borrower and the Guarantor, using the Guarantor's consolidated financial statements.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard administrative provision defining the methodology for calculating financial covenants. It does not impose new financial burdens but clarifies the reporting standard.
obligations: Borrower must measure the Interest Coverage Ratio on a combined basis using consolidated financial statements provided by the Guarantor.

clauses.heading: 10. Collateral/Mortgages. The term "Collateral" as that term is d
clauses.text: efined in Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement shall incorporate and include, without limitation, all real and personal property lien interests granted by END to Bank by the following: (i) mortgage liens or deeds of trust (as applicable) encumbering END's proved producing and proved non-producing oil, gas and other leasehold and mineral interests (including, without limitation, behind-the pipe values), on a first priority basis, including without limitation, those properties situated in the States of North Dakota and Montana (the "END Mortgages"), and (ii) a first priority security interest in substantially all of END's personal property according to the terms of a certain Pledge, Security Agreement and Assignment instrument dated as even date with this First Amendment, in form and substance satisfactory to Bank (the "END Security Agreement"). The term "Mortgages" as that term is defined in Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement shall incorporate and include the END Mortgages.
clauses.plain_english: This clause expands the definition of 'Collateral' and 'Mortgages' under the existing loan agreement to include specific oil and gas property liens in North Dakota and Montana, as well as a first-priority security interest in the borrower's personal property as defined in a new security agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard collateral expansion clause common in secured lending amendments. While it increases the scope of assets pledged, it is a typical requirement for loan amendments involving additional security.
obligations: Grant first priority mortgage liens on proved producing and non-producing oil, gas, and mineral interests in North Dakota and Montana
Grant a first priority security interest in substantially all personal property pursuant to the END Security Agreement
rights: Bank is entitled to first priority lien interests in the specified real and personal property
cross_references: Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement

clauses.heading: 11. Amended Louisiana Mortgage. EL, as mortgagor, and CrossFirst,
clauses.text: as mortgagee, are parties to a certain Mortgage, Assignment of As-Extracted Collateral, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing dated as of September 20, 2018, as corrected by instrument dated November 7, 2018, whereby EL granted a first priority mortgage lien and security interest in all of its oil and gas leases, leasehold interests, and related assets located in the State of Louisiana (the "Original Louisiana Mortgage"). As a condition precedent to CrossFirst's obligations under this First Amendment, CrossFirst requires that the Original Louisiana Mortgage be amended and modified to incorporate and secure repayment of all amounts extended under and evidenced by the increased Revolver Commitment, all according to the terms of a certain First Amendment to Mortgage, Assignment of As-Extracted Collateral, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing dated on or about the date of the First Amendment (the "Amended Louisiana Mortgage").
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower (EL) must amend its existing Louisiana mortgage to ensure that the increased loan amount (Revolver Commitment) is fully secured by the same oil and gas assets previously pledged to the Bank (CrossFirst). This amendment is a mandatory requirement that must be met before the Bank is obligated to proceed with the First Amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard condition precedent in a loan amendment, requiring the borrower to update security documentation to reflect increased debt. It is a routine administrative and legal requirement for secured lending.
obligations: EL must amend and modify the Original Louisiana Mortgage to incorporate and secure repayment of all amounts extended under the increased Revolver Commitment.
rights: CrossFirst has the right to withhold its obligations under the First Amendment until the Amended Louisiana Mortgage is executed.

clauses.heading: 12. Conditions Precedent. The Borrower shall execute and deliver,
clauses.text: or cause to be executed and delivered, to the Bank, each of the following as express conditions precedent to the effectiveness of the amendments and modifications contemplated by this First Amendment: ( This First Amendment; a ) ( The replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note); b ) ( The END Mortgages; c ) ( The END Security Agreements; d ) ( The Amended Louisiana Mortgage; e ) ( The Guaranty Agreement; f ) ( The obligation of Borrower to furnish the Bank with appropriate g certificates from the State of North Dakota that demonstrate END is registered and qualified to do business in the State of North Dakota, shall be an express condition subsequent and must be accomplished by Borrower to the Bank's satisfaction no later than April 12, 2019, and failure of Borrower to timely satisfy such condition subsequent shall constitute an Event of Default hereunder without further or other notice from the Bank. ) ( Payment to the Bank of the fully earned and non-refundable one h percent (1.0%) loan origination fee in the amount of $76,900.00 ) concurrently herewith in immediately available funds (US Dollars); and ( Closing certificates from each of the Borrowers. i )
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower must deliver several documents and payments to the Bank as conditions for the amendment to take effect. Additionally, the Borrower must provide proof of registration in North Dakota by April 12, 2019; failure to do so will result in an immediate Event of Default.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause includes a condition subsequent that triggers an immediate Event of Default without notice if the Borrower fails to provide specific state registration certificates by a hard deadline, creating significant operational risk for the Borrower.
obligations: Execute and deliver the First Amendment
Execute and deliver the replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note)
Execute and deliver the END Mortgages
Execute and deliver the END Security Agreements
Execute and deliver the Amended Louisiana Mortgage
Execute and deliver the Guaranty Agreement
Furnish the Bank with certificates from the State of North Dakota demonstrating registration and qualification to do business by April 12, 2019
Pay the Bank a 1.0% loan origination fee of $76,900.00
Deliver closing certificates from each of the Borrowers
rights: Bank's right to receive documents and payment as conditions precedent
Bank's right to declare an Event of Default upon failure to satisfy the North Dakota registration condition
deadlines: April 12, 2019 for North Dakota registration certificates

clauses.heading: 13. Fees and Expenses. Borrower shall promptly (in any event with
clauses.text: in ten (10) days of receipt of an invoice therefor) reimburse the Bank for its reasonable legal fees and all filing and recording fees and other costs and expenses reasonably incurred in connection with the negotiation, preparation and closing of the transactions contemplated by this First Amendment, including the reasonable attorney fees and costs and expenses of Bank's legal counsel and any applicable mortgage taxes.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower is required to pay the Bank back for all reasonable legal fees, filing fees, and other costs related to the negotiation and closing of this amendment within ten days of receiving an invoice.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard expense reimbursement clause common in loan amendments. The requirement is limited to 'reasonable' fees and costs, which provides a standard level of protection against excessive charges.
obligations: Borrower must reimburse the Bank for reasonable legal fees, filing fees, recording fees, and other costs incurred in connection with the First Amendment within ten (10) days of receiving an invoice.
rights: Bank has the right to be reimbursed for reasonable legal and transaction-related expenses.
deadlines: Within ten (10) days of receipt of an invoice.

clauses.heading: 14. Ratification. The remaining terms, provisions and conditions
clauses.text: set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement shall remain in full force and effect as long as any Indebtedness of the Borrower is owing to the Bank and/or the Revolver Commitment remains in effect. The Borrower adopts, restates, confirms and ratifies the warranties, covenants and representations set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement (except the representations and warranties that specify a specific date or period of time) and further represents to the Bank that, as of the date hereof, no Default or Event of Default exists under the Loan Agreement (including this First Amendment). All references to the "Loan Agreement" appearing in any of the Loan Documents shall hereafter be deemed references to the Existing Loan Agreement as amended, modified and supplemented by this First Amendment.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower confirms that the original loan agreement remains active and valid. The Borrower also reaffirms their previous promises and legal statements, while confirming that they are currently in compliance with the agreement and no default has occurred.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard ratification and reaffirmation clause common in loan amendments. It ensures continuity of obligations and confirms the borrower's current compliance status, which is standard practice for lenders.
obligations: Borrower must maintain the Existing Loan Agreement in full force and effect
Borrower must adopt, restate, confirm and ratify warranties, covenants and representations from the Existing Loan Agreement
Borrower must represent that no Default or Event of Default exists as of the date of the amendment

clauses.heading: Amendment and the terms of the Existing Loan Agreement, the t
clauses.text: erms of this First Amendment shall control and govern, and the agreements shall be interpreted so as to carry out and give full effect to the intent of this First Amendment. Each Borrower and the Bank hereby adopt, ratify and confirm the Loan Agreement, as amended hereby, and acknowledge and agree that the Loan Agreement and all other Loan Documents, are and remain in full force and effect. Borrower acknowledges and agrees that its liabilities and obligations under the Loan Agreement and all other Loan Documents, including the Security Instruments, are not impaired in any respect by this First Amendment. Original Borrower further ratifies and confirms the mortgage liens and security interests granted thereby pursuant to Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement and hereby grants and regrants such mortgage liens and security interests in favor of the Bank.
clauses.plain_english: The parties confirm that the original loan agreement remains in effect as modified by this amendment. The Borrowers acknowledge that their existing obligations and security interests (mortgage liens) remain fully enforceable and are not diminished by this amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard ratification and confirmation clause common in loan amendments to ensure continuity of security interests and obligations. It does not introduce new, unusual, or one-sided burdens.
obligations: Borrower must ratify and confirm the Loan Agreement and all other Loan Documents
Borrower must grant and regrant mortgage liens and security interests in favor of the Bank
rights: Bank retains the benefit of existing mortgage liens and security interests
cross_references: Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement

clauses.heading: 15. SUBMISSION TO JURISDICTION. BORROWER AND THE BANK HEREBY
clauses.text: CONSENT TO THE JURISDICTION OF ANY OF THE LOCAL, STATE, AND FEDERAL COURTS LOCATED WITHIN TULSA COUNTY, OKLAHOMA AND WAIVES ANY OBJECTION WHICH THE BORROWER MAY HAVE BASED ON IMPROPER VENUE OR FORUM NON CONVENIENS TO THE CONDUCT OF ANY PROCEEDING IN ANY SUCH COURT.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower and the Bank agree that any legal disputes will be handled in the courts of Tulsa County, Oklahoma. The Borrower also gives up the right to argue that Tulsa County is an inconvenient or improper place for these legal proceedings.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard forum selection clause. While it limits the Borrower's ability to challenge venue, it is common in commercial loan agreements and does not impose unusual or excessive burdens.
obligations: Borrower must submit to the jurisdiction of local, state, and federal courts in Tulsa County, Oklahoma.
Borrower must waive objections based on improper venue or forum non conveniens.
rights: Bank has the right to initiate legal proceedings in Tulsa County, Oklahoma.

clauses.heading: 16. WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL. BORROWER FULLY, VOLUNTARILY AND
clauses.text: EXPRESSLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION OR PROCEEDING TO ENFORCE OR DEFEND ANY RIGHTS UNDER THE LOAN AGREEMENT (INCLUDING THIS FIRST AMENDMENT), THE SECURITY INSTRUMENTS OR UNDER ANY AMENDMENT, SUPPLEMENT, INSTRUMENT, DOCUMENT OR AGREEMENT DELIVERED (OR WHICH MAY IN THE FUTURE BE DELIVERED) IN CONNECTION HEREWITH OR ARISING FROM ANY BANKING RELATIONSHIP EXISTING IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT. THE BORROWER AGREES THAT ANY SUCH ACTION OR PROCEEDING SHALL BE TRIED BEFORE A COURT AND NOT BEFORE A JURY.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower agrees to give up its right to a jury trial for any legal disputes related to the loan agreement or the banking relationship, agreeing instead to have such matters decided by a judge.
clauses.risk_justification: Waiver of jury trial is a standard boilerplate provision in commercial loan agreements and is generally enforceable, though it represents a waiver of a fundamental legal right.
obligations: Borrower must waive the right to a trial by jury in any action or proceeding related to the loan agreement or banking relationship.

clauses.heading: 17. Governing Law. The Loan Agreement (including the First Amendm
clauses.text: ent) shall be deemed to have been made or incurred under the Laws of the State of Oklahoma and shall be construed and enforced in accordance with and governed by the Laws of Oklahoma.
clauses.plain_english: This agreement is governed by and will be interpreted according to the laws of the State of Oklahoma.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard boilerplate governing law clause. It provides legal certainty regarding which jurisdiction's laws apply to the contract.

clauses.heading: 18. Release. In consideration of the amendments contained herein,
clauses.text: Borrower hereby waives and releases Bank from any and all claims and defenses, known or unknown, as of the effective date of this First Amendment, with respect to the Loan Agreement (including this First Amendment) and the Loan Documents and the transactions contemplated thereby.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower agrees to give up any legal claims or defenses it may have against the Bank regarding the loan agreement and related documents up to the date of this amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a broad release of all claims and defenses, including unknown ones, which significantly limits the Borrower's legal recourse against the Bank for past actions.
obligations: Borrower must waive and release Bank from all claims and defenses known or unknown as of the effective date

clauses.heading: 19. Counterparts. This First Amendment may be executed in multipl
clauses.text: counterparts, each of which, when so executed, shall constitute an original copy. Transmission by facsimile or electronic transmission (e.g., pdf format) of an executed counterpart of this First Amendment by any party shall be deemed to constitute due and sufficient delivery of such counterpart and such facsimile or electronic transmission shall be deemed to be an original counterpart of this First Amendment.
clauses.plain_english: This agreement can be signed in separate copies, and all copies together will count as one original document. Sending a signed copy via fax or email (like a PDF) is legally valid and counts as delivering an original.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard boilerplate clause regarding the execution and delivery of documents. It is industry-standard and carries no significant legal risk.
rights: Parties may execute the agreement in multiple counterparts
Parties may deliver the agreement via facsimile or electronic transmission

clauses.heading: 20. Reaffirmation of Indebtedness. Borrower acknowledges the term
clauses.text: s of this First Amendment and ratifies and affirms its obligations under, and acknowledges, renews and extends its continued liability under, each Loan Document to which it is a party, and agrees that each Loan Document to which it is a party remains in full force and effect.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower confirms that all existing loan agreements remain valid and that they continue to be legally bound by all obligations and liabilities previously agreed upon.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard reaffirmation clause common in loan amendments to ensure continuity of existing obligations; it does not create new, unusual, or excessive liabilities.
obligations: Borrower must ratify and affirm its obligations under each Loan Document to which it is a party.

clauses.heading: 5 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have caused this First
clauses.text: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have caused this First Amendment to be duly executed and delivered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, in multiple counterparts effective as of the day and year first above written.
clauses.plain_english: This clause confirms that the parties have officially signed the amendment in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and that it is effective as of the date stated in the document.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard execution and witness clause (testimonium) confirming the formal signing and effectiveness of the agreement.

recommended_actions: Review the broad release of claims in Clause 18 to ensure no material unknown claims are being inadvertently waived.
Verify the financial impact of the Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR) on liquidity, as this is a mandatory principal reduction.
Ensure compliance with the conditions precedent in Clause 12, specifically the delivery of North Dakota registration certificates by the specified deadline.
Assess the impact of the amendment fee structure (25 basis points on outstanding amounts) on future operational flexibility.
Confirm that the consolidated financial reporting requirements under the Guaranty Agreement align with the Borrower's current accounting capabilities.
